key.name: dock-orientation
key.description: Whether the dock sits at the top or the bottom of the screen. The extension stores this value and does not apply it yet.

key.name: panel-icons
key.description: Role-to-label map of the panel status area, written by the extension when it enables. Preferences reads this because it cannot import the shell.

key.name: monitor-panels
key.description: Maps a monitor connector to that monitor's panel settings. Each entry may contain panel-enabled (boolean) and icons (a dictionary of icon id to boolean). Missing monitors and icons stay enabled. panel-enabled shows the top bar. Each icon chooses whether that button is shown on the bar.
